articles.title: 500-Rupee Bet Turns Tragic: Youth Swept Away in Yamuna
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Baghpat, UP: A shocking incident took place at Yamuna bridge in Niwada village, Kotwali area, where a youth went missing after jumping into the river for a ₹500 bet. The missing youth, Junaid, had challenged his friend to a swimming bet.

body.html:
Baghpat, UP: A shocking incident took place at Yamuna bridge in Niwada village, Kotwali area, where a youth went missing after jumping into the river for a ₹500 bet.

The missing youth, Junaid, had challenged his friend to a swimming bet. He swam for some distance but was soon swept away by the strong current.

Despite hours of search by locals, no trace of him has been found. SDRF and NDRF teams have now joined the rescue operation.

articles.title: Panvel Clash: Vlogger’s Refusal to Speak Marathi During Ganesh Prep Sparks Viral Debate
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A heated clash over the Marathi–Hindi language issue broke out in Panvel, Maharashtra, involving travel vlogger Vijay Chandel. The incident occurred during Ganesh festival preparations when locals asked Chandel to converse in Marathi.

body.html:
A heated clash over the Marathi–Hindi language issue broke out in Panvel, Maharashtra, involving travel vlogger Vijay Chandel. The incident occurred during Ganesh festival preparations when locals asked Chandel to converse in Marathi. He refused, insisting, “Hindi hi bolunga, Marathi kabhi nahi (I will only speak Hindi, never Marathi).”

The situation escalated as women from the group reminded him, “Maharashtra mein rehte ho (You live in Maharashtra),” but Chandel stood firm, declaring he would speak only Hindi “till death.” A video of the altercation has gone viral, fuelling a fierce online debate on language identity and regional pride.

Later, Chandel clarified that the dispute was also tied to disagreements over Ganesh Utsav arrangements in his society. He has since filed a police complaint, alleging harassment and mental pressure. Some individuals have apologised, but online trolling continues.

The viral video has reignited the long-running Marathi vs Hindi language debate in Maharashtra.

articles.title: Lucknow: 20 Kg Beef Seized From Thar in Hazratganj Parking, Owner Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Police in Lucknow recovered 20 kg of suspected beef from a black Mahindra Thar parked at the multi-level parking in Hazratganj on September 2. The vehicle, without a registration number, belonged to Mohammad Wasif, who was present at the spot and arrested immediately.

body.html:
Police in Lucknow recovered 20 kg of suspected beef from a black Mahindra Thar parked at the multi-level parking in Hazratganj on September 2. The vehicle, without a registration number, belonged to Mohammad Wasif, who was present at the spot and arrested immediately.

Sub-inspector Shivani Singh led the operation. Police sealed the car, registered a case under the UP Prevention of Cow Slaughter Act, and sent the seized meat for laboratory testing.

Officials said investigations are underway to determine whether Wasif was working alone or linked to a larger supply network.

articles.title: Jaipur Maulana’s Tantra-Mantra Sex Scandal Rocks Jodhpur, Police Hunt On
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A sensational case from Rajasthan has exposed madrasa operator Maulana Afzal, accused of exploiting women under the guise of occult rituals. Viral videos show him in obscene acts with multiple women, sparking massive outrage in Jodhpur.

body.html:
A sensational case from Rajasthan has exposed madrasa operator Maulana Afzal, accused of exploiting women under the guise of occult rituals. Viral videos show him in obscene acts with multiple women, sparking massive outrage in Jodhpur.

Police said Afzal, who posed as a tantra-mantra expert, targeted distressed women—especially those struggling with infertility—luring them with false promises of spiritual solutions before abusing them. Around 5–6 such videos have surfaced online.

His madrasa and shop are now locked, and he has been absconding since the scandal broke. Though no victim has lodged a complaint yet, police are investigating and trying to trace both the accused and the women seen in the clips.

Locals, shocked by the revelations, are demanding strict action. Authorities have assured that Afzal will face consequences once caught.
